confidence_notes: Holistic estimate from general knowledge of Cape Town price levels; no live listings or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation varies widely by neighborhood and grading, and July is winter low season, though South African school holidays may lift some demand. Cocktail and wine were set relative to beer because direct knowledge was weak. The FX figure comes from a web search summary attributed to the RBA Exchange Rates Overview for 13 Oct 2026; that page was not opened directly, and no 14 Oct observation was confirmed.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was formally used. The basis is general knowledge of South African tourist-hub price levels, with accommodation set for a July low-season window and restaurant and drink prices set for typical Cape Town menus.
